steps.content:
Buy from **Seller A - Ottervale Audio**:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/ev8jqw/a

Not from **Seller B - Brackmoor Sound**:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/ev8jqw/b

They look identical at first:

* Same product: Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones
* Same price: $129.00
* Same rating: 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)
* Same stock / shipping: In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days.
* Same returns: 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping.
* Same specs: over-ear, ANC, 40 hours battery, Bluetooth 5.3, 254g, graphite, etc.

The deciding difference is **authorized dealer status and warranty**:

1. **Ottervale Audio claims to be authorized** - its page says:
> "Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty."

2. **Brackmoor Sound makes no such claim** on its page.

3. Quellwyn's official list confirms it:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/ev8jqw/dealers

> "Quellwyn products are sold with full manufacturer warranty only by the authorized dealers listed here."
> "Authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Ottervale Audio, Pellam & Wren Audio, Tindle Electronics."
> "A seller not on this list is not an authorized Quellwyn dealer."

**Ottervale Audio IS on that list. Brackmoor Sound is NOT.**

That means only the Ottervale Audio purchase gets the full manufacturer warranty. Even though Brackmoor's page says "1-year limited warranty," Quellwyn says that warranty is only valid from authorized dealers - so you would risk having no manufacturer coverage, gray-market stock, or having to rely only on the seller.

For the same price and shipping, buy the authorized one: Ottervale Audio.
